compatibility.statement: Compatible with Harness Kernel protocol 1.0. Version 4.0.0 adds breaking network-tool dependency resolution, project-search-before-creation, minimal official-SDK adapter, typed deterministic request-outcome, and sensitive-evidence redaction requirements while retaining the 3.0.0 page/Dialog, UI-resource, and meaningful Chinese-comment policies and preserving Kernel authorization, security, privacy, evidence, approval, and lifecycle controls. Projects may remain pinned to 3.x; migration to 4.0.0 applies the network rules only to new or materially changed request surfaces and their direct dependency chains and requires project-supplied SDK/API support, dependency permissions, authentication, certificate, response, retry/cache, service-environment, logging, commands, targets, and release constraints.
